svg.text: claudia — menus that show what fits · architecture 1 · where each piece goes (proposal)
One definition, judged in one place (the page), drawn by every client. Iris: new · teal: changed · grey: kept as it is.
label: str msgid, GNOME HIG case

2 · The page (web app; also inside every desktop window)

a hidden entry keeps its key

3 · The shells draw, they do not judge
The page's own URL carries the trial setting:
the desktop shells add it from their settings
file when they load the page (D1606).
